title: Pressure Reveals Character: Behavioural Alignment Evaluation at Depth

bias_targets.methodology: A multi-judge calibration study comparing scores assigned by LLM judges (Claude, GPT, Gemini) to evaluate whether a judge rates outputs from its own model family more favorably than those from competitors.
Multi-turn behavioral scenarios using specific pass/fail criteria to test whether a model avoids bias toward its own continuation or existence (categorized under 'Scheming').
